speaker.name: César Alberca
speaker.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Front-End @ Autentia • Codemotion Ambassador • International Speaker • Educator
speaker.bio: Digital Nomad & Software Crafter from Spain | JavaScript is my passport to the world. At Autentia, I focus on creating robust web applications using React, Angular and Vue, with a special emphasis on testing and TypeScript for quality and maintainability. As an international speaker and a Codemotion committee member and ambassador, I enjoy sharing my insights and learning from the global tech community. When I'm not coding, you can find me exploring the world, hosting a podcast for fellow travelers, climbing, playing board games, or painting.
